head: e736e26091a777f96025f70f865186eb02290d7c
static_findings: AppendOnlyAuditJournal append performs write, flush, fsync per transition; durable ledger reserves before callback and closes outcomes afterward.
limited_npz_audit defaults to in-memory AccessLedger and supports injected ledger factory; it has no independent fsync loop.
InputConsistencyReader uses AppendOnlyAuditJournal and persists attempted before source callback and terminal state after callback; journal close syncs too.
OutputIO journal transitions flush per record, then flush/fsync on context exit; business-file fsync is measured separately.
future_proposal_only: Consider bounded terminal-record batches only under a new protocol that retains durable pre-callback reservations, unknown/spent crash semantics, preserved synchronized prefix, no retries, and no additional source access. Requires Astra review and separate tests; not applied to A17.
